evidence.claim: A composed workflow run that invokes a council as a stage and consumes the typed decision downstream uses exactly one scheduler and one event log.
A council failure inside a workflow is classified by reading the workflow node's failure policy (family=model-error, action=abort, source=workflow.failure_policy), not by a council-local policy.

falsifiable_answers.council_failure_classification: Classified under the workflow failure policy ({'action': 'abort', 'family': 'model-error', 'message': 'vendor 500', 'ref_seq': 4, 'source': 'workflow.failure_policy', 'stage_id': 'deliberate'}). A swallowed failure is not a silent pass ({'action': 'abort', 'family': 'swallowed-failure', 'message': 'unclassified council.turn.failed seq=8 (inner family model-error)', 'ref_seq': 8, 'source': 'workflow.failure_policy', 'stage_id': 'deliberate'}).
falsifiable_answers.second_scheduler_or_event_log: No on the happy path: event_log_count=1 scheduler_count=1. A planted second EventLog is detected (event_log_count=2).

negative_controls.description: A council.turn.failed event with no workflow.failure.classified must fire detect_swallowed_council_failure. The same failure with a policy classification must be silent. A SwallowingInvoker through the live bridge must not silently pass.
An invoker that constructs a second EventLog during a council stage must make ControlPlaneCensus.single_control_plane false and classify duplicate-control-plane under the workflow policy.
A policy naming a family outside the closed set fails validation.
